SELECT v.id as vlogId, v.vloger_id as vlogerId, u.face as vlogerFace, u.nickname as vlogerName, v.title as content, v.tag as tag, v.url as url, v.cover as cover, v.width as width, v.height as height, v.like_counts as likeCounts, v.comments_counts as commentsCounts, v.is_private as isPrivate, v.is_deleted as isDeleted FROM vlog v LEFT JOIN users u ON v.vloger_id = u.id WHERE v.is_private = 0 AND (v.is_deleted = 0 OR v.is_deleted IS NULL) AND (u.is_deleted = 0 OR u.is_deleted IS NULL)
AND v.title like '%${paramMap.search}%'
ORDER BY v.created_time DESC

SELECT v.id as vlogId, v.vloger_id as vlogerId, u.face as vlogerFace, u.nickname as vlogerName, v.title as content, v.tag as tag, v.url as url, v.cover as cover, v.width as width, v.height as height, v.like_counts as likeCounts, v.comments_counts as commentsCounts, v.is_private as isPrivate FROM vlog v LEFT JOIN users u ON v.vloger_id = u.id WHERE v.id = #{paramMap.vlogId} AND (v.is_deleted = 0 OR v.is_deleted IS NULL) AND (u.is_deleted = 0 OR u.is_deleted IS NULL)

SELECT v.id as vlogId, v.vloger_id as vlogerId, v.title as content, v.tag as tag, v.url as url, v.cover as cover, v.width as width, v.height as height, v.like_counts as likeCounts, v.comments_counts as commentsCounts, v.is_private as isPrivate FROM vlog v LEFT JOIN my_liked_vlog mlv ON v.id = mlv.vlog_id LEFT JOIN users u ON mlv.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN users vloger ON v.vloger_id = vloger.id WHERE u.id = #{paramMap.userId} AND v.is_private = 0 AND (v.is_deleted = 0 OR v.is_deleted IS NULL) AND (vloger.is_deleted = 0 OR vloger.is_deleted IS NULL) ORDER BY v.created_time DESC

SELECT v.id as vlogId, v.vloger_id as vlogerId, u.face as vlogerFace, u.nickname as vlogerName, v.title as content, v.tag as tag, v.url as url, v.cover as cover, v.width as width, v.height as height, v.like_counts as likeCounts, v.comments_counts as commentsCounts, v.is_private as isPrivate FROM vlog v LEFT JOIN fans f ON v.vloger_id = f.vloger_id LEFT JOIN users u ON f.vloger_id = u.id WHERE v.is_private = 0 AND (v.is_deleted = 0 OR v.is_deleted IS NULL) AND (u.is_deleted = 0 OR u.is_deleted IS NULL) AND f.fan_id = #{paramMap.myId} ORDER BY v.created_time DESC

SELECT v.id as vlogId, v.vloger_id as vlogerId, u.face as vlogerFace, u.nickname as vlogerName, v.title as content, v.tag as tag, v.url as url, v.cover as cover, v.width as width, v.height as height, v.like_counts as likeCounts, v.comments_counts as commentsCounts, v.is_private as isPrivate FROM vlog v LEFT JOIN fans f ON v.vloger_id = f.fan_id LEFT JOIN users u ON f.fan_id = u.id WHERE v.is_private = 0 AND (v.is_deleted = 0 OR v.is_deleted IS NULL) AND (u.is_deleted = 0 OR u.is_deleted IS NULL) AND f.vloger_id = #{paramMap.myId} AND f.is_fan_friend_of_mine = 1 ORDER BY v.created_time DESC

SELECT v.id as vlogId, v.vloger_id as vlogerId, u.face as vlogerFace, u.nickname as vlogerName, v.title as content, v.tag as tag, v.url as url, v.cover as cover, v.width as width, v.height as height, v.like_counts as likeCounts, v.comments_counts as commentsCounts, v.is_private as isPrivate, v.is_deleted as isDeleted FROM vlog v LEFT JOIN users u ON v.vloger_id = u.id WHERE 1=1
AND (u.is_deleted = 0 OR u.is_deleted IS NULL)
AND v.title like '%${paramMap.search}%'
ORDER BY v.created_time DESC
